title: Rory and the Moonlit Hillside
verses:
As the shadows stretched long on the moss of the glade,
And the sun dropped away in a blanket of gold,
Rory walked through the quiet and silvery shade,
Where the tales of the night were beginning to fold.

When Nia swooped down from the peak of the crest,
With Psittaco nestled right under her wing,
They sought out a hollow for evening rest,
Where breezes in branches would whisper and sing.

Then Ricky ran up with a bounce in his stride,
While Tilly stepped slow with a basket of moss.
Rory welcomed his friends to the sleepy hillside,
Where the soft little leaves began swaying across.

Then Benny sank down like a mountain of peace,
And stretched out his neck in the cool evening air.
He hummed as the sounds of the valley decrease,
Content with the quiet they all came to share.

So Rory curled up in the center of all,
With Ricky beside him beginning to yawn.
They listened together as night came to fall,
To sleep through the dark till the glow of the dawn.

The moon floated high over meadow and stream,
And brushed all their shadows with silver and white.
Each friend drifted off in a magical dream,
As silence took hold of the beautiful night.
